entities.summary: Chen Yuefang was a Chinese basketball player who competed in the 1984 Summer Olympics. At 2.18 m, she was one of the tallest female Chinese basketball players ever, but cerebral thrombosis and anemia forced her to retire in 1985 at the age of 22. She died at the age of 37.
